mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Weights, costs, and boundaries are exact rationals; fibre counts are integers; miss penalty 32.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: Under the base menu the eps-dial chooses q_perm for eps ≤ 11/27 and q_id above. Under the extended menu it chooses q_perm for eps ≤ 7/27 and q_pair01 above (q_pair01 also serves pair_eq because it keeps bits 0 and 1; it beats q_id 12 < 16 and beats q_pair23 by name at the 12-fibre tie). The mirrored concern pair chooses q_stab0/q_stab_last under both menus. delta_bag chooses q_perm under both menus.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the 55 sweep points per menu and the four registered concerns; existential for the boundary separation.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Registered menus, cost rule, tie-break; no other screens or tasks.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: The transportable content is identified as the symmetry layer of the choice function; the menu-relative content is the boundary. Neither is a new primitive.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Door 1 (menu-relative gold, representing_in_menu), door 3 (cost rule, 11/27 anchor), Paper F (tie-break), Paper A (representability).
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Reversal swaps first_bit/last_bit, q_stab0/q_stab_last, q_pair01/q_pair23; bag, parity, q_perm, q_rot, q_id are fixed. The choice function must commute on the mirrored pair under both menus.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: At eps = 0 both menus reproduce Paper F's q_perm. At the exact ties (11/27, 7/27) the fewest-fibres rule keeps q_perm. If the boundaries had coincided the verdict is boundary_menu_stable, not a fabricated difference.
